document_zh: 随包自检闸门台账（十道）

nature.kind_zh: 既有检查的可数化登记，不是新增检查
nature.kind_en: A countable register of checks already running; it adds no new check
nature.derivation_zh: 十道闸门的口径、当前读数与历史查获案例全部由包内既有文件推出：`changelog.md` 的逐版登记、`visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json` 的 records 与 findings、`visual/assets/review-archive.json` 的三方审查发现、`manifest.json` 的文件条目、`metrics.json` 的复算登记、以及两个随包校验器的实际退出码。本文件不产生任何新主张，也不产生任何指标数值。
nature.derivation_en: Every gate definition, current reading and historical catch is derived from files already in this package: the version-by-version entries in `changelog.md`, the records and findings in `visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json`, the three-way review findings in `visual/assets/review-archive.json`, the file entries in `manifest.json`, the recalculation entries in `metrics.json`, and the actual exit codes of the two shipped checkers. This file makes no new claim and produces no metric value.
nature.metrics_effect_zh: 无。本文件不产生任何指标数值；`metrics.json` 中十项待实测指标保持 unknown。
nature.metrics_effect_en: None. This file produces no metric value; the ten pending metrics in `metrics.json` stay unknown.
nature.honesty_rule_zh: `caught_real_defects` 只登记该闸门口径本身实际查获过的缺陷。口径本身未有查获案例的闸门，该字段为空数组并由 `caught_real_defects_status_zh` 写明「未有登记案例」；与该闸门相邻但不属其口径的历史修复登记在 `adjacent_registered_cases`，不计入查获数。
nature.honesty_rule_en: `caught_real_defects` lists only defects the gate's own criterion actually caught. Where the criterion has caught nothing, the array is empty and `caught_real_defects_status_en` says so; historical fixes adjacent to but outside the criterion sit in `adjacent_registered_cases` and are never counted as catches.

gates.checks_zh: `proposal.md` 与 `proposal.en.md` 的三项计数：总行数（wc -l 口径）、非空行的逐行结构类型序列、表格行数与逐行列数。
gates.checks_en: Three counts across `proposal.md` and `proposal.en.md`: total lines (wc -l), the line-by-line structural-type sequence of non-empty lines, and table row count with per-row column counts.
gates.criterion_zh: 三项两侧全等，且逐行结构类型不一致数为 0；任一项不等即失败，正文任何加行必须双语同位。
gates.criterion_en: All three counts equal on both sides and zero structural-type mismatches line by line; any inequality fails the gate, and any added line must be added at the same position in both languages.
gates.current_reading_en: Lines 868/868 (wc -l); non-empty lines 612/612; table rows 280/280; zero structural-type mismatches.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 中文版正文两段之间缺一个空行，Markdown 语义下被视为同一段落，而英文版对应位置有空行；逐行结构类型比对自该处起整体偏移一行。
caught_real_defects.found_en: A blank line was missing between two Chinese paragraphs, merging them under Markdown semantics while the English side kept the separation; the line-by-line structural comparison shifted by one line from that point.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 补入空行；折叠空行后结构类型序列为零不一致，确认差异只在段落分隔而非结构本身。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The blank line was restored; with blank lines folded the type sequence showed zero mismatches, confirming the difference lay in paragraph separation rather than structure.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: QA 自证链的 R3 走查记录深层字段与当前版本脱节：focus_sequence 步数、焦点数与图像数、量测日期、图版文件数英文侧 28 与中文侧 32 不一致。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The deep fields of the R3 walkthrough record had drifted from the current version: the focus_sequence step list, focus and image counts, measurement dates, and a plate-file count of 28 on the English side against 32 on the Chinese side.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: focus_sequence 61 步全表重写，焦点数与图像数按实测更正为 20/20，正文行数统一 wc -l 口径 847，图版文件数英文侧补齐至 32。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The 61-step focus_sequence was rewritten in full, focus and image counts corrected to 20/20 as measured, the prose line count unified to 847 under wc -l, and the English plate-file count brought up to 32.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 英文展示页第 8 章十节点卡与第 15 章前八张风险卡为占位文本，与中文逐卡内容不等价。
caught_real_defects.found_en: On the English display page the ten node cards in chapter 8 and the first eight risk cards in chapter 15 held placeholder text and were not card-for-card equivalent to the Chinese.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 恢复十种具体 AI 关闭通道与八种具体停止条件，与中文逐卡等价。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The ten concrete AI-off channels and eight concrete stop conditions were restored, making the cards equivalent to the Chinese.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: QA 记录自身的两处等价登记有误：R2-02 登记的标题层级序列漏录两个三级标题、与其自称的 29 项检查不自洽；R2-03 的英文读数长期停留在 260／188，与同一条目的中文读数不一致。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Two equivalence entries in the QA record itself were wrong: R2-02's heading-level sequence omitted two third-level headings and was inconsistent with its own claim of 29 checks, and R2-03's English readings had been stuck at 260/188, disagreeing with the Chinese readings in the same entry.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: R2-02 按实测补全（标题总数与双语一致性结论不变）；R2-03 按当前版本改写。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: R2-02 was completed against measurement (its heading total and bilingual conclusion unchanged) and R2-03 rewritten against the current version.

gates.name_zh: 证据锚点解析率闸门（七类）
gates.checks_zh: 正文七类机读证据锚点 `[source:]` `[metric:]` `[data:]` `[standard:]` `[depth:]` `[assumption:]` `[self_check:]` 是否全部能在包内结构化文件中解引用，以及双语两侧各类锚点的 id 集合是否相等。
gates.checks_en: Whether all seven machine-readable anchor types in the prose — `[source:]`, `[metric:]`, `[data:]`, `[standard:]`, `[depth:]`, `[assumption:]`, `[self_check:]` — dereference against structured files in the package, and whether each type's id set is identical on both language sides.
gates.criterion_zh: 死链数为 0，且逐类计数双语全等；`[data:]` 目标必须是可被查看器解析的结构化文件而非叙述文件。
gates.criterion_en: Zero dead anchors, per-type counts equal across languages, and every `[data:]` target a structured file the viewer can parse rather than a prose file.
gates.current_reading_zh: source 81／81、data 70／70、metric 68／68、standard 13／13（四类合计 232／232）；另计 depth 37／37、assumption 12／12、self_check 4／4；死链 0。
gates.current_reading_en: source 81/81, data 70/70, metric 68/68, standard 13/13 (232/232 across the four sampled types); separately depth 37/37, assumption 12/12, self_check 4/4; zero dead anchors.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 两处 `[data:]` 引用指向 `.md` 文件，站端查看器无法解析，证据面板出现死链。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Two `[data:]` references pointed at `.md` files, which the portal viewer cannot parse, producing dead links in the evidence panel.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 改指结构化文件，修正后 128 条证据全部解析。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: They were repointed at structured files; after the fix all 128 evidence references resolved.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 官方查看器支持七类锚点，本包此前只使用五类——证据面板「边界与自检」桶自 v1.0 起恒为 0，而 `assumptions.json` 十二条前提与 `self_check.json` 四项自检早已在册且可被解析，只差正文引用。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The official viewer supports seven anchor types but this package used only five: the evidence panel's boundary-and-self-check bucket had read zero since v1.0, even though the twelve assumptions and four self-checks were already registered and parseable — only the prose references were missing.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 在正文相应叙述处补 `[assumption:]` 十二处与 `[self_check:]` 四处，双语同位、id 集合两侧相等，全部指向既有结构化内容，零新增主张。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: Twelve `[assumption:]` and four `[self_check:]` anchors were added at the matching positions in both languages with identical id sets, all pointing at content already registered — no new claim.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 反向引用断言护栏 refcheck 首跑即捕获两处图引旧题（正文图题与现行图版标题不一致）。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The refcheck back-reference guard caught two stale figure captions on its very first run, where the prose caption no longer matched the current plate title.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 两处图引按现行图版标题改写；护栏自此每版收口零失败方可发布。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: Both captions were rewritten against the current plate titles; the guard now has to pass with zero failures before any version is released.

gates.checks_zh: 送审视觉的三项覆盖：正文引用的每张图是否带图题并在渲染报告页注入宽高、离线展示页每个 `img` 是否带非空 `alt`、每件图版是否中英成对或在 `manifest.json` 中以 `language: neutral` 登记。
gates.checks_en: Three coverage checks on review-facing visuals: every figure referenced in the prose carries a caption and gets width/height injected in the rendered report page, every `img` on the offline display page carries a non-empty `alt`, and every plate is either a bilingual pair or registered as `language: neutral` in `manifest.json`.
gates.criterion_zh: 三项均为全覆盖，缺一即失败；成对性缺口不得以中性登记掩盖，中性登记须是同图单件的事实陈述。
gates.criterion_en: All three must be complete; a single gap fails the gate, and a missing pair may never be papered over by a neutral declaration — a neutral declaration must be a factual statement that the plate is one language-free artefact.
gates.current_reading_zh: 正文 16／16 张图带图题、报告页双语 16／16 张注入宽高；离线展示页 `img` 20／20 带非空 `alt`；图版文件 39 件（16 对中英成对 + 7 张几何核验图以 `language: neutral` 登记）。
gates.current_reading_en: 16/16 prose figures carry captions and 16/16 images in both report pages carry injected width/height; 20/20 `img` elements on the offline display page carry non-empty `alt`; 39 plate files (16 bilingual pairs plus 7 verification overlays registered as `language: neutral`).
gates.superseded_reading_zh: 展示页替代文本读数历史上登记为 18／18（v6.8）；三维主脊章静态后备加入后按实测升为 20／20（v7.3 复测），本闸门以当前读数为准。
gates.superseded_reading_en: The display-page alternative-text reading was historically registered as 18/18 (v6.8); after the 3-D spine chapter's static fallbacks were added it was re-measured to 20/20 (v7.3), and this gate uses the current reading.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 六件场景概念图此前未纳入 768 像素接收口径检查，属登记缺口；其标注层文字为 9—11 px，在评审接收分辨率下不可读。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The six concept scene images had never been brought into the 768-pixel receiving-resolution check — a registration gap — and their annotation layers ran at 9 to 11 px, illegible at the resolution reviewers receive.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 标注层全部文字提升至 ≥12 px 后重渲六件，接收口径检查扩展覆盖场景图。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: All annotation text was raised to 12 px or more and the six images re-rendered, with the receiving-resolution check extended to cover scene images.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 英文版 `site-overview` 走廊带左右端地名与重点区标签在英文长文本下溢出画布（北京北·西直门被左缘裁断、北五环与众智园标签被右缘裁断）；`land-use` 英文脚注一行超出画布底部。
caught_real_defects.found_en: On the English `site-overview` the corridor-end place names and key-area labels overflowed the canvas under longer English strings (Beijing North / Xizhimen clipped at the left edge, the North Fifth Ring and Zhongzhiyuan labels at the right); one English footnote line on `land-use` ran past the bottom of the canvas.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 地名锚点方向反转并加边界钳制、右端区标自动翻转至图钉左侧、脚注措辞缩短；中英四张图版重出并联动四册重排。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: Place-name anchors were flipped with boundary clamping, the right-hand area label auto-flipped to the left of its pin, and the footnote shortened; four plates were re-rendered in both languages and the four books re-laid out.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: `site-overview.en.png` 左栏出现重复的双语短语并造成压字。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The left column of `site-overview.en.png` repeated a bilingual phrase and produced overlapping type.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 删去重复短语并重渲，压字消除。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The duplicate phrase was deleted and the plate re-rendered, clearing the overlap.

gates.name_zh: HTML 离线自足闸门（零外部请求）
gates.checks_zh: 离线展示页 `visual/index.html` 与 `visual/index.en.html` 及其加载的样式与脚本，是否含任何外部请求或提交型交互：`iframe`、`form`、`fetch()`、`XMLHttpRequest`、`WebSocket`、`EventSource`、`sendBeacon()`、远程 `@import`、远程 `url()`、远程 `script src`、远程 `link href`、远程媒体 `src`、媒体 `autoplay`。
gates.checks_en: Whether the offline display pages `visual/index.html` and `visual/index.en.html` and the styles and scripts they load contain any external request or submitting interaction: `iframe`, `form`, `fetch()`, `XMLHttpRequest`, `WebSocket`, `EventSource`, `sendBeacon()`, remote `@import`, remote `url()`, remote `script src`, remote `link href`, remote media `src`, or media `autoplay`.
gates.criterion_zh: 十三条禁用模式任一命中即失败；第三方组件只能以离线单文件随包，且其许可与转换步骤须随包登记。
gates.criterion_en: A hit on any of the thirteen forbidden patterns fails the gate; third-party components may ship only as offline single files, with their licence and any conversion steps registered in the package.
gates.current_reading_zh: 十三条禁用模式零命中；唯一第三方展示层组件 three.js r160 以 MIT 许可离线单文件随包，转换步骤与上游哈希登记于 `visual/assets/three-license.json`。
gates.current_reading_en: Zero hits across the thirteen forbidden patterns; the single third-party display-layer component, three.js r160, ships as an offline single file under MIT, with its conversion steps and upstream hash registered in `visual/assets/three-license.json`.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: three.js 官方 UMD 构建加载时在控制台打印一条带网址的弃用告警，与本包「完全离线、不加载远程脚本」的承诺视觉冲突——读者在控制台看到网址，无法当场判断页面是否发起了外部请求。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The official three.js UMD build printed a deprecation warning carrying a URL to the console on load, which visually contradicted this package's promise of full offline operation with no remote scripts — a reader seeing a URL in the console cannot tell on the spot whether the page made an external request.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 改为对官方 module 构建做机械可复现重封装，唯一改动为末尾 export 语句换全局赋值，上游其余字节零改动；416 个导出全数保留经核验，转换步骤与上游哈希全文披露。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The official module build was mechanically and reproducibly repackaged, the only change being the trailing export statement swapped for a global assignment with every other upstream byte untouched; all 416 exports were verified as preserved and the conversion steps and upstream hash fully disclosed.

adjacent_registered_cases.note_zh: `scene.js` 与 `spine3d.js` 缺数据集加载失败降级路径，`JZ_SCENE` 缺失时页面会停在空画布——属离线降级口径而非外部请求口径，故不计入本闸门查获数。
adjacent_registered_cases.note_en: `scene.js` and `spine3d.js` lacked a dataset-load failure path, leaving a blank canvas when `JZ_SCENE` was absent — an offline-degradation matter rather than an external-request one, so it is not counted as a catch by this gate.

gates.name_zh: 几何非回归闸门（EPSG:4548 复算）
gates.checks_zh: 提交几何逐要素投影至 EPSG:4548 复算面积与长度，与 `metrics.json` 的登记值逐项比对；同时比对图纸、图版与展示页上的同源读数是否与结构化登记一致。
gates.checks_en: Every submitted geometry feature is projected to EPSG:4548, its area or length recomputed, and compared item by item against the values registered in `metrics.json`; the same-source readings printed on the drawings, plates and display page are compared against the structured register as well.
gates.criterion_zh: 任一项超出登记舍入位即失败；结构化登记与图面读数不一致时，先独立复算判定哪一侧陈旧，不得默认改结构化文件。
gates.criterion_en: Any deviation beyond the registered rounding fails the gate; where the structured register and a printed reading disagree, an independent recomputation decides which side is stale — the structured file is never changed by default.
gates.current_reading_en: Site boundary 11,412,825.386 sqm; dissolved building footprint 372,890.968 sqm (per-polygon sum 373,521.394 sqm, with BLDG-001 and BLDG-004 overlapping by 630.426 sqm); dissolved green space 2,432,035.047 sqm; dissolved public space 2,074,629.805 sqm; the deliberate green/public overlap 448,404.185 sqm. Every item agrees with the register in `metrics.json`.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: PROV-KEY-003 大钟寺重点区临时框线落在北京北站一带，距真实大钟寺约 2.4 km，属历史错位——图版上印着「大钟寺」的标注与其地名并不对位。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The provisional Dazhongsi key-area frame PROV-KEY-003 sat near Beijing North station, about 2.4 km from the real Dazhongsi — a long-standing misplacement, so the plates carried a Dazhongsi label that did not match the place it named.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 框线移至真实大钟寺板块（面积与原框相当），ROAD-004、OP-04／08／09、BLDG-004、PUBLIC-007／008 随迁且同层要素零重叠；可达域读数由双独立管线互证重算。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The frame was moved onto the real Dazhongsi block at comparable area, with ROAD-004, OP-04/08/09, BLDG-004 and PUBLIC-007/008 relocated with it and no same-layer overlap remaining; the reachability readings were recomputed and cross-checked by two independent pipelines.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: `site-overview` 与 `land-use` 图版上的十个节点按编号奇偶等距摆放，与 `geometry/constraints.geojson` 的真实落位最大偏差约 8 km——图面是示意排布，却被当作落位读图。
caught_real_defects.found_en: On the `site-overview` and `land-use` plates the ten nodes had been laid out at even spacing by odd and even numbering, deviating from their true positions in `geometry/constraints.geojson` by up to about 8 km — a diagrammatic arrangement being read as located geometry.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 两图由栅格复用转为矢量素底重绘，十节点自此按 `constraints.geojson` 真实落位，OP-04 加断点环。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: Both plates were redrawn as vector artwork instead of reusing a raster, placing the ten nodes at their true positions from `constraints.geojson` and adding a break ring at OP-04.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 几何归位后仍有旧读数残留：展示页双语第 07 章守则段的差集读数停留在 237,622 ㎡／48.16%，OP-04 证据链档案两处叙述字段与九十天实施包的踏勘工作量仍按旧换挂口径书写。
caught_real_defects.found_en: After the relocation, stale readings survived: the difference-area figures in chapter 7 of both display pages still read 237,622 sqm / 48.16%, and two narrative fields in the OP-04 evidence-chain archive plus the survey workload in the ninety-day pack still used the superseded attachment convention.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 读数更新为 225,058 ㎡／46.67%，叙述字段改按接口固定口径，踏勘工作量由两备选合计 889 米改为 564 米，复演器复跑零不符。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The readings were updated to 225,058 sqm / 46.67%, the narrative fields rewritten under the interface-fixed convention, and the survey workload corrected from 889 m to 564 m across the two alternatives, with the replayer rerunning at zero disagreements.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 四册图纸中绿地与公共空间包络的蓄意重叠面积仍停留在 452,986.656 ㎡ 这一陈旧值，与 `metrics.json` 自 v6.6 起登记的 448,404.185 ㎡ 不符，全值共出现八处。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Across the four books the deliberate green/public overlap area still read 452,986.656 sqm, disagreeing with the 448,404.185 sqm registered in `metrics.json` since v6.6, with the full value appearing in eight places.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 对当前提交几何独立复算判定图纸侧为陈旧值而非结构化文件有误（两包络交集 448,404.185 ㎡、占场地 3.9289%，与既有登记精确一致），八处全值与配套比例全包归一。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: An independent recomputation on the current geometry determined that the drawings were stale rather than the structured file wrong (the two envelopes intersect at 448,404.185 sqm, 3.9289% of the site, exactly matching the existing register), and all eight occurrences plus the accompanying ratio were normalised package-wide.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: A3 页 11 可达域台账两处行级缺陷：OP-04 行的差集面积与占比（48,000 ㎡／55.9%）与 OP-02 行逐字相同，系行复制；OP-09 行（14,697 ㎡／38.1%）的口径与其余各行不一致。同页四项汇总读数中的 48.16% 与所附图版主标题的 46.7% 口径不一致。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Two row-level defects in the reachability ledger on A3 page 11: the OP-04 row's difference area and share (48,000 sqm / 55.9%) were word for word identical to the OP-02 row — a copied row — and the OP-09 row (14,697 sqm / 38.1%) used a convention inconsistent with the rest. The page's 48.16% summary also disagreed with the 46.7% in the title of the plate it accompanied.
caught_real_defects.fix_en: All ten rows were recomputed from the same source with one script: OP-04 became 50,920 sqm / 49.7%, OP-09 became 20,204 sqm / 54.3%, OP-08 became 31,655 sqm / 57.0% with the descending order adjusted accordingly; the network total length was corrected from 20,166 m to 20,141 m; and the four summary readings became 482,266.876 sqm, 257,208.435 sqm, 225,058.441 sqm and 46.6668%, unified with the plate title's convention.

gates.checks_zh: `manifest.json` 的 `files` 数组逐条：路径是否存在于包内、是否带 `sha256` 摘要、条目数是否与包内实际交付文件数一致、双语成对件是否带 `language` 与 `translation_of`。
gates.checks_en: Every entry in the `files` array of `manifest.json`: whether the path exists in the package, whether it carries a `sha256` digest, whether the entry count matches the files actually delivered, and whether bilingual counterparts declare `language` and `translation_of`.
gates.criterion_zh: 除 `manifest.json` 自身条目外，缺任一摘要即失败（自身条目不能自含自身摘要，属结构性排除而非遗漏）。
gates.criterion_en: Apart from the `manifest.json` entry itself, a single missing digest fails the gate — that one exclusion is structural, since a file cannot contain its own digest, not an omission.
gates.current_reading_zh: 条目 135 条，134 条带 `sha256`；唯一无摘要条目为 `manifest.json` 自身；`language` 登记 100 条、`translation_of` 登记 25 条。
gates.current_reading_en: 135 entries, 134 carrying `sha256`; the only entry without a digest is `manifest.json` itself; 100 entries declare `language` and 25 declare `translation_of`.
gates.caught_real_defects_status_zh: 未有登记案例。本闸门口径（摘要覆盖本身）在历版中未查获过缺失。
gates.caught_real_defects_status_en: No registered case. The gate's own criterion — digest coverage — has never caught a missing digest in any version.

adjacent_registered_cases.note_zh: 反向引用断言护栏 refcheck 首跑捕获 QA 记录中的字节漂移（登记字节数与实际文件不符）——属读数漂移口径而非摘要覆盖口径，故不计入本闸门查获数。
adjacent_registered_cases.note_en: The refcheck back-reference guard caught a byte drift in the QA record on its first run, where a registered byte count no longer matched the file — a reading-drift matter rather than a digest-coverage one, so it is not counted as a catch by this gate.

gates.name_zh: PDF 字体审计闸门（仅 OFL 子集）
gates.name_en: PDF font audit gate (OFL subsets only)
gates.checks_zh: 遍历四册 PDF（A3 双语册与 A0 双语展板）的页面与 XObject 资源，清点全部嵌入字体，逐项判定是否属于已清权的开放字体许可子集。
gates.checks_en: Walk the pages and XObject resources of all four PDFs (the bilingual A3 books and the bilingual A0 boards), inventory every embedded font, and judge each against the cleared open-font-licence subsets.
gates.criterion_zh: 出现任一非 OFL 条目即失败；许可正本须随包收录并可由内容哈希重建校验。
gates.criterion_en: A single non-OFL entry fails the gate; the licence text must ship in the package and be rebuildable and checkable against its content hash.
gates.current_reading_zh: 四册零非 OFL 条目；嵌入字体为 Source Han Sans SC 的 Regular／Medium／Bold 三个子集；许可正本随包收录于 `visual/assets/font-license-ofl.json`，逐行数组以换行符连接后 SHA-256 应等于 `plain_text_sha256`。
gates.current_reading_en: Zero non-OFL entries across the four books; the embedded fonts are the Regular, Medium and Bold subsets of Source Han Sans SC; the licence text ships in `visual/assets/font-license-ofl.json`, where joining the line array with newlines rebuilds a document whose SHA-256 must equal `plain_text_sha256`.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 审计发现四册 PDF 自首版起，经浏览器打印管线的字体栈回退混入了未清权的系统字体子集——HelveticaNeue、Georgia、Menlo、STSongti-SC——与权利登记「仅嵌入思源黑体 OFL 子集」不符。这是一处真实的合规缺陷，不是排版瑕疵。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The audit found that since the first version all four PDFs had picked up uncleared system font subsets through the browser print pipeline's font-stack fallback — HelveticaNeue, Georgia, Menlo and STSongti-SC — contradicting the rights register's claim that only Source Han Sans OFL subsets were embedded. This was a genuine compliance defect, not a typesetting blemish.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 把全部生成器的字体声明钉死到思源黑体（衬线口号与等宽标签的视觉区分改由字重、字距与表格数字实现），四册重渲后经全册字体审计（遍历页面与 XObject 资源）确认零非 OFL 条目。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: Every generator's font declaration was pinned to Source Han Sans (the serif slogan and monospaced labels re-expressed through weight, tracking and tabular figures instead), and after re-rendering, a full-book audit walking pages and XObject resources confirmed zero non-OFL entries.

gates.checks_zh: `visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json` 的四组记录 R1—R4：条目总数是否与文件自述一致、每条 `findings` 是否带级别与处理去向、每条局限是否如实在册、每条读数是否标注复测日期或引自既有登记。
gates.checks_en: The four record groups R1 to R4 in `visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json`: whether the item total matches the file's own statement, whether every finding carries a severity and a disposition, whether every limitation is registered as fact, and whether every reading is dated or marked as carried over from an existing register.
gates.criterion_zh: 条目数与自述不符、findings 缺去向、或局限被省略，任一即失败；「本轮未重跑」的条目必须如实标注，不得以旧读数冒充新实测。
gates.criterion_en: A mismatch between the item total and the file's own statement, a finding without a disposition, or an omitted limitation each fail the gate; items not re-run in the current round must say so and may never pass an old reading off as fresh measurement.
gates.current_reading_zh: R1 六项 + R2 八项 + R3 十项 + R4 五项 = 29 项；findings 八条（两条已修复、两条复测确认已修复、四条观察项如实登记）；已知局限七条；本文件明示不产生任何指标数值。
gates.current_reading_en: R1 six plus R2 eight plus R3 ten plus R4 five equals 29 items; eight findings (two fixed, two confirmed fixed on re-test, four registered as observations); seven known limitations; the file states explicitly that it produces no metric value.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 中文页面（`lang="zh-CN"`）的章节导航地标可访问名为英文小写 `chapters`，与页面语言不符，也与同页其余四处中文 `aria-label` 的体例不一致；经可访问性树核对确认该地标在树中的名称确为 `chapters`。
caught_real_defects.found_en: On the Chinese page (`lang="zh-CN"`) the chapter-navigation landmark had the accessible name `chapters` in lowercase English, out of step with the page language and with the other four Chinese `aria-label` values on the same page; the accessibility tree confirmed the landmark really was named `chapters`.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 中文版改为「章节导航」，英文版同步改为 `Chapters`；修复后重跑可访问性树，双语计数断言全等。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The Chinese version became 章节导航 and the English version `Chapters`; the accessibility tree was re-read after the fix and the bilingual count assertions came back equal.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 节点选中时的状态播报文本由中英两版共用同一行拼接代码生成，句号硬编码为中文全角句号，实测英文播报以中文全角句号结尾。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The status announcement for a selected node was assembled by one line of code shared by both languages with the full stop hard-coded as a Chinese full-width period, so the measured English announcement ended in a Chinese full-width period.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 改为引用语言字典的 `period` 字段（中文全角、英文半角）；2026-08-15 复测确认已修复。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The code now reads the `period` field from the language dictionary (full-width for Chinese, half-width for English); re-tested on 2026-08-15 and confirmed fixed.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: A3 双语册英文版逐页结构块比对与溢出检测查获一处 19.6 毫米的内容溢出。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The page-by-page structural comparison and overflow detection on the English A3 book found one content overflow of 19.6 millimetres.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 已修复，当前溢出检测结果为 0。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: Fixed; the current overflow detection result is zero.

adjacent_registered_cases.note_zh: 本闸门自身的两处登记错误（R2-02 标题层级序列漏录两个三级标题、R2-03 英文读数停留 260／188）由 PG-01 查获并订正，登记于 PG-01-D4，不在此重复计数。
adjacent_registered_cases.note_en: Two registration errors in this gate's own record — R2-02's heading sequence omitting two third-level headings and R2-03's English readings stuck at 260/188 — were caught and corrected by PG-01 and are registered there as PG-01-D4, not counted twice here.

gates.name_zh: 两路独立盲审归档闸门
gates.checks_zh: `visual/assets/review-archive.json` 是否把本包宣称的「维护方实测 + 两路独立盲审」登记为可核对象：三方是否齐备、两路盲审是否运行于不同模型与运行时、审查期间是否互不知晓对方结论、每路是否带分级与发现摘要、至少一路是否带报告全文与内容哈希、独立性边界是否如实声明。
gates.checks_en: Whether `visual/assets/review-archive.json` turns the claimed maintainer-probes-plus-two-blind-reviews into a checkable object: all three parties present, the two blind reviews run on different models and runtimes, neither seeing the other's conclusions during review, each carrying a severity grading and findings summary, at least one carrying the full report text and its content hash, and the independence boundary stated as fact.
gates.criterion_zh: 缺任一路、缺分级、缺全文或哈希、或把委托方发起的审查描述为第三方机构认证，任一即失败。
gates.criterion_en: A missing track, a missing grading, a missing full text or hash, or describing a commissioned review as third-party institutional certification each fail the gate.
gates.current_reading_zh: 已归档一次专项审查 RV-SEB-2026-08-15（基线提交 4bf557874），三方齐备：维护方九组实测探针；盲审 A（Claude Opus 子代理，只读契约）阻断 3・高 6・中 6・低 8；盲审 B（GPT-5.6 Sol via Codex CLI，只读沙箱）阻断 2・高 5・中 6・低 2，带 `report_sha256` 与报告全文。独立性边界如实声明为「由本方案团队发起、委托并验收，不构成任何第三方机构认证」。
gates.current_reading_en: One dedicated review is archived, RV-SEB-2026-08-15 (baseline commit 4bf557874), with all three parties present: nine maintainer probe sets; blind review A (a Claude Opus subagent under a read-only contract) grading 3 blocking, 6 high, 6 medium, 8 low; blind review B (GPT-5.6 Sol via Codex CLI in a read-only sandbox) grading 2 blocking, 5 high, 6 medium, 2 low, carrying `report_sha256` and the full report text. The independence boundary is stated as fact: commissioned, run and accepted by this proposal's team, constituting no third-party institutional certification.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 盲审 A 与盲审 B 同时判为阻断级：SEB 规范只「建议采用」CC BY-SA 4.0 而从未实际授予，两个外部采用方在无有效许可状态下运行，规范却已主张下游署名义务。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Both blind reviews graded this as blocking: the SEB specification only recommended CC BY-SA 4.0 and had never actually granted it, so the two external adopters were operating without a valid licence while the specification already asserted downstream attribution duties.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 新增随包授予文件 `visual/assets/seb-license-grant.json`——著作权人授予声明加法定正文全文与重建哈希，文本著作权许可与机构托管两件事明确拆分，采用方许可依据即时成立。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: A grant file was added to the package, `visual/assets/seb-license-grant.json`, carrying the rightsholder's grant statement, the full statutory text and a rebuild hash, separating the copyright licence from institutional hosting so that adopters have an immediate licence basis.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 盲审 A 判定 FS-041「已修复」声称被实验证伪，回执缺自家 schema 十四项必填字段中的十三项，且历史版本引用无处解引用——采用方锁定引用的 v0.2 原文只存在于 git 历史。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Blind review A found the FS-041 claim of being fixed falsified by experiment, receipts missing thirteen of the fourteen fields their own schema requires, and historical version references with nowhere to dereference — the v0.2 text adopters had pinned existed only in git history.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 回执按 schema 重铸为一版一号，十三条失败样本逐条登记（含「修复本身违规」与许可缺陷）；v0.2.0／v0.3.0 规范快照按字节随包发布并登记上游提交号与内容哈希。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: Receipts were recast under the schema as one number per version with all thirteen failed samples registered individually (including a fix that itself violated the rule, and the licence defect); byte-exact v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 snapshots were shipped with upstream commit ids and content hashes.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 维护方九组探针查获：`chain-run` 无词表合格性校验、`includes` 词缀误伤合法角色词、缺 `decision` 块导致裸崩 TypeError、声明的来源文件缺失时静默跳过并打印与事实相反的说明。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The maintainer's nine probe sets caught a `chain-run` with no lexicon eligibility check, an `includes` affix match that wrongly rejected legitimate role words, a bare TypeError crash on a missing `decision` block, and a silent skip that printed a statement contrary to fact when a declared source file was absent.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 合格性判据升格进规范条文并由两实现共同执行；`SOURCE_MISMATCH` 由私有判定码升格为条文判据（声明不可读整次拒绝）；缺 `decision` 块改为组件级采用跳过并在输出中打印。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The eligibility criteria were raised into the specification text and enforced by both implementations; `SOURCE_MISMATCH` was promoted from a private code to a specified criterion that rejects the whole run when a declaration cannot be read; and a missing `decision` block became a component-level adoption skip printed in the output.

gates.checks_zh: 两个互不共享代码的随包校验器 `visual/assets/seb-tabletop-run.js` 与 `visual/assets/seb-op04-chain-run.js`，对同一套判据是否给出一致判定：逐条样例的判定与期望比对、判定码是否同出一张登记表、读数不符项计数、以及两者的退出码。
gates.checks_en: Whether the two shipped checkers that share no code — `visual/assets/seb-tabletop-run.js` and `visual/assets/seb-op04-chain-run.js` — reach the same verdicts under one criteria set: fixture verdicts compared against expectations, verdict codes drawn from one registered table, the count of disagreeing figures, and both exit codes.
gates.criterion_zh: 任一样例判定与期望不符、读数不符项大于 0、判定码不在规范登记表内、或任一退出码非 0，即失败；同一非法输入在两个实现下必须得到同一判定。
gates.criterion_en: Any fixture verdict differing from its expectation, any disagreeing figure, any verdict code outside the registered table, or a non-zero exit code fails the gate; the same illegal input must draw the same verdict from both implementations.
gates.current_reading_zh: `node seb-tabletop-run.js` 退出码 0，样例 40 条与期望 40／40 一致（通过 13、拒绝 27）；`node seb-op04-chain-run.js` 退出码 0，声明判定 4／4 与期望一致、读数不符项 0。两次运行均不写入 `metrics.json`。
gates.current_reading_en: `node seb-tabletop-run.js` exits 0 with 40 of 40 fixtures matching expectation (13 accepted, 27 rejected); `node seb-op04-chain-run.js` exits 0 with 4 of 4 declared verdicts matching and zero disagreeing figures. Neither run writes to `metrics.json`.
gates.reproduction_command: cd visual/assets && node seb-tabletop-run.js && node seb-op04-chain-run.js

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 同一核心判据在两个实现下结果相反：注入非法角色词后，tabletop 触发 `ADOPTER_LEXICON_INVALID_TOKEN` 并以退出码 2 拒绝，而 OP-04 链复演器只过滤非空字符串、完全不执行合格性规则，仍以退出码 0 判定 4／4 通过。公共基准最基本的实现互操作性不成立。
caught_real_defects.found_en: One core criterion produced opposite results in the two implementations: with an illegal role token injected, the tabletop checker raised `ADOPTER_LEXICON_INVALID_TOKEN` and exited 2, while the OP-04 chain replayer merely filtered for non-empty strings, applied no eligibility rule at all, and still exited 0 with 4 of 4 passing — the most basic implementation interoperability a public baseline needs did not hold.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 违例码登记表写入规范正文，两实现一码集一行为；链复演器补合格性校验与范围声明（本包专用、`LineString` 仅支持两点线段、超限拒跑不静默截断）；`String()` 强转把数字放行的路径一并封堵。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The violation-code table was written into the specification and both implementations brought onto one codeset with one behaviour; the chain replayer gained the eligibility check and a scope declaration (package-specific, `LineString` limited to two-point segments, refusing to run rather than silently truncating beyond that); and the `String()` coercion path that let numbers through was closed.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 首轮加锁把禁用后缀表塞在工具代码里，正面违反本包自设的「工具不持有私有词表」铁律，且子串匹配误伤 `officer`（基准本体词表成员）与 `community steward` 等合法角色词——修复本身构成新的违规。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The first locking attempt put the forbidden-suffix table inside the tool code, directly violating this package's own rule that tools hold no private lexicon, and its substring matching wrongly rejected legitimate role words such as `officer` (itself a member of the baseline lexicon) and `community steward` — the fix was itself a violation.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: v0.3.1 终稿把合格性判据（禁用后缀表 26 项、词尾语义、逐词证据条目）全部移入规范条文，工具不再持有任何私有词表；该「修复本身违规」作为失败样本公开登记。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The final v0.3.1 moved the whole eligibility criterion — the 26 forbidden suffixes, the word-ending semantics and the per-token evidence entries — into the specification text so that no tool holds a private lexicon, and the self-violating fix was published as a registered failed sample.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: OP-04 链复演器存在同段二次挂接缺陷，同一段线位被重复计入挂接判定。
caught_real_defects.found_en: The OP-04 chain replayer double-attached the same segment, counting one segment twice in the attachment verdict.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 修复复演器；节点挂接改为接口固定口径（物理接口线不因 AI 开关改变，接口缺席即不可达），全部读数回填后 chain-run 零不符、tabletop 二十条样例不受影响。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The replayer was fixed and node attachment moved to the interface-fixed convention, where the physical interface line does not change with the AI switch and an absent interface means unreachable; with all readings refilled, chain-run showed zero disagreements and the tabletop's twenty fixtures were unaffected.

caught_real_defects.found_zh: 盲审 B 查获样例集对五个已实现分支零覆盖——判据写了、实现了，但没有任何一条样例会走到那些分支，通过率因此不证明判据可执行。
caught_real_defects.found_en: Blind review B found the fixture set gave zero coverage to five implemented branches: the criteria were written and implemented, but no fixture ever reached those branches, so the pass rate proved nothing about executability.
caught_real_defects.fix_zh: 样例由 15 条扩至 20 条（组件级采用正例、枚举违例、未知指标、未知等级、未知风险条目），五个分支从零覆盖到有正反样例；演示样例改用合成 id，真实点位 id 一律强制逐字对齐。
caught_real_defects.fix_en: The fixture set grew from 15 to 20 (component-level adoption, enum violations, unknown metrics, unknown levels and unknown risk entries), giving all five branches positive and negative fixtures; demonstration fixtures moved to synthetic ids and real node ids were forced into exact alignment.

summary.note_zh: 查获数只统计各闸门口径本身查获的缺陷；相邻登记案例三条不计入。PG-06 摘要覆盖闸门为唯一未有登记案例的闸门，如实登记。
summary.note_en: The catch count includes only defects caught by each gate's own criterion; the three adjacent cases are excluded. PG-06, the digest-coverage gate, is the one gate with no registered case, and is registered as such.

limitations_zh: 本文件是方案方自查闸门的登记，不是第三方认证、不是合规声明、不是辅助技术使用者的实测报告。
十道闸门中，PG-01、PG-02、PG-03、PG-05、PG-06、PG-08 以脚本量测与结构比对执行；PG-04 与 PG-10 可由随包脚本当场复演；PG-07 依赖 PDF 资源遍历；PG-09 是归档完整性检查，不对被归档审查的结论作二次判断。
闸门通过与否不构成对现场服务可用性的任何声明；现场绩效的状态由包内既有条款维持为未获授权、未现场运行。
历史查获案例的版本号与叙述逐条取自 `changelog.md` 与 `visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json`，本文件不新增任何事实。
limitations_en: This file registers the proposer's own self-check gates. It is not third-party certification, not a compliance claim, and not a report of testing by assistive-technology users.

Of the ten gates, PG-01, PG-02, PG-03, PG-05, PG-06 and PG-08 run as script measurement and structural comparison; PG-04 and PG-10 can be replayed on the spot with the shipped scripts; PG-07 depends on walking PDF resources; PG-09 checks archive completeness and passes no second judgement on the conclusions of the reviews it archives.
Passing a gate constitutes no statement about on-site service availability; the on-site status stays, as the package already states, unauthorised and not running.
The version numbers and narratives of the historical catches are taken item by item from `changelog.md` and `visual/assets/qa-proofing-record.json`; this file adds no fact.
